bio: A cool location right in the centre. The Bistro, accommodated in a centuries-old building, is accessible via the impressive glass-roofed atrium courtyard, which boasts an inviting terrace. The tables laid out inside, where a relaxed atmosphere reigns, are also appealing. The space, done out in a trendy, pared-back decor, has a small bar and open kitchen, as well as eye-catching vaulted ceilings and art. The menu is small but enticing, and includes, for instance, steak or Italian influences. It is also possible to drop in just for a cocktail or glass of wine....
